package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/teacherdialog"
)

type provisionTeacherDialog interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, input teacherdialog.ProvisionInput) (domain.TeacherDialogBinding, error)
}

type TeacherDialogHandler struct {
	ProvisionUC provisionTeacherDialog
}

type ensureTeacherDialogRequest struct {
	ContextType domain.LearningContextType `json:"context_type"`
	ContextID   string                     `json:"context_id"`
}

func (handler TeacherDialogHandler) Ensure(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized")
		return
	}
	var request ensureTeacherDialogRequest
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 16<<10))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&request); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid request body")
		return
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "request body must contain one JSON object")
		return
	}
	binding, err := handler.ProvisionUC.Execute(r.Context(), teacherdialog.ProvisionInput{
		StudentID: studentID, ContextType: request.ContextType, ContextID: request.ContextID,
	})
	switch {
	case err == nil:
		status := http.StatusOK
		if binding.Created {
			status = http.StatusCreated
		}
		writeJSON(w, status, binding)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext):
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrDialogStateUnavailable):
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "dialog service unavailable")
	default:
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to provision teacher dialog")
	}
}
